name: Airplane
summary: Passenger airliner in side view facing right, with windows, wings, tail fin and two engines; for travel and sky scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the craft (its gear) stands on y; it flies in the air above the ground

params.name: s
params.note: scale: about 990 px wide and 580 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: fly = gentle hover and the engine fans spin

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the airliner faces left

author: krakujs
